FEDERAL AVIATION ACT OF 195811
The Federal Aviation Act of 1958 was repealed by Public Law 103–272 except for the following section.

subsection.heading: National Disaster Areas.—
subsection.content: Before the 180th day following the date of the enactment of this section, the Administrator, for safety and humanitarian reasons, shall issue such regulations as may be necessary to prohibit or otherwise restrict aircraft overflights of any inhabited area which has been declared a national disaster area in the State of Hawaii.

subsection.heading: Exceptions.—
subsection.content: Regulations issued pursuant to subsection (a) shall not be applicable in the case of aircraft overflights involving an emergency or a ligitimate scientific purpose.
